## Question or proposed change

State the ambiguity or inconsistency. Do not propose a code-only fix.

## Exact passage

Quote the file, section number, and wording from `docs/` (the Markdown transcriptions),
for example `Architecture.md Section 6.2`.

## Why it matters

Which metric, policy decision, task label, or reproducibility guarantee is at risk?

## Proposed resolution

If you have one, give it here. Any accepted resolution must land as a docs PR first and
be recorded in `docs/DECISIONS.md`.

## Decision needed from the maintainer

What exactly should be confirmed before implementation continues?
